_doc: For each FRED series the macro signals read through backtest/data/macro.py _fred_value_at (observation date <= as_of over the latest-revised FRED observations), what that filter ignores, measured from the ALFRED vintage cache over 2022-05-05..2026-05-05: publication_lag_days = realtime_start minus the observation date on each date's FIRST vintage (days the value was unknowable after its date); share_of_dates_revised = dates carrying more than one vintage. T10Y2Y is included as the control: yield_curve_regime reads it through the vintage path, which applies realtime_start <= as_of <= realtime_end and is not exposed.
